title: MSBuild runner: in xmlV1 results, the results are duplicated when multiple assemblies are passed

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
It looks like the xmlv1 result contains the repeated results for each assembly. It makes a large report for cruisecontrol.net

This is an example result for 2 assemblies

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<assemblies>
  <assembly name="F:\code\DBPublishing\FilterTests\bin\Debug\FilterTests.DLL" configFile="F:\code\DBPublishing\FilterTests\bin\Debug\FilterTests.dll.config" run-date="2014-08-15" run-time="10:12:17" time="0.025" total="0" passed="0" failed="0" skipped="0" environment="64-bit .NET 4.0.30319.18444 [collection-per-class, parallel]" test-framework="xUnit.net 2.0.0.2738">
    <class name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" time="193.902" total="2" passed="2" failed="0" skipped="0">
      <test name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests.TestConvert" type="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" method="TestConvert" result="Pass" time="31.654">
        <traits>
          <trait name="Category" value="onBuild" />
        </traits>
      </test>
      <test name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests.testTest" type="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" method="testTest" result="Pass" time="162.248">
        <traits>
          <trait name="Category" value="onBuild" />
        </traits>
      </test>
    </class>
  </assembly>
  <assembly name="F:\code\DBPublishing\PublishingTests\bin\Debug\PublishingTests.DLL" configFile="F:\code\DBPublishing\PublishingTests\bin\Debug\PublishingTests.dll.config" run-date="2014-08-15" run-time="10:12:19" time="194.202" total="2" passed="2" failed="0" skipped="0" environment="64-bit .NET 4.0.30319.18444 [collection-per-class, parallel]" test-framework="xUnit.net 2.0.0.2738">
    <class name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" time="193.902" total="2" passed="2" failed="0" skipped="0">
      <test name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests.TestConvert" type="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" method="TestConvert" result="Pass" time="31.654">
        <traits>
          <trait name="Category" value="onBuild" />
        </traits>
      </test>
      <test name="PublishingTests.PublishingTests.testTest" type="PublishingTests.PublishingTests" method="testTest" result="Pass" time="162.248">
        <traits>
          <trait name="Category" value="onBuild" />
        </traits>
      </test>
    </class>
  </assembly>
</assemblies>
```
